gloss: title; topic; Nichiren chant; empty slogan

definitions.gloss: title (of a book or talk); subject; topic
definitions.explanation: The title of a written work, speech or discussion, or the theme it deals with. Somewhat formal or old-fashioned; {題名|だいめい} and タイトル are more common for titles today.

definitions.gloss: the Nichiren chant (南無妙法蓮華経); (お題目) a slogan only paid lip service
definitions.explanation: In Nichiren Buddhism, the chanted phrase {南無妙法蓮華経|なむみょうほうれんげきょう}. From the endless repetition, お{題目|だいもく} came to mean a fine-sounding principle or slogan that is repeated but not acted on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{講演|こうえん}→講演：02735_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{題目|だいもく}。
⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{題目|だいもく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: To decide the topic of the meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{題目|だいもく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}→提出：03542_teishutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指導教員|しどうきょういん}→指導教員：09970_shidoukyouin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}して→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: I settled the title of my thesis with my supervisor before submitting it.

examples.japanese: お{題目|だいもく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{唱|とな}える→唱える：10467_tonaeru⟧。
⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{題目|だいもく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わった。
examples.english: The reform ended up as nothing but a slogan.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{安全第一|あんぜんだいいち}→安全第一：24120_anzendaiichi⟧」⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧お{題目|だいもく}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧で、⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{守|まも}られていなかった→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
examples.english: "Safety first" was just a slogan; on the site, nobody followed it.

notes:
Sense 2 almost always takes the prefix お-: お{題目|だいもく}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{題目|だいもく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{唱|とな}える→唱える：10467_tonaeru⟧: to chant the daimoku; to repeat empty slogans
- お{題目|だいもく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる: to end as mere words
- お{題目|だいもく}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧: in name only

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{題名|だいめい}→題名：03421_daimei⟧: title of a work; the everyday word for sense 1
